question: Approve the ideation direction: retire the legacy TeamCreate surface, keep and xfail-bind selected-team, and ship the unbound template-slot fix as the root cause?

artifacts.summary: Ideation refuted the filing's central premise: the live proof does NOT demand a team_name — its oracle requires team_name ABSENT (dispatch_recovery_assert_test.go:181), and the CI red's only failing predicate was subagent_type="", traced to an unbound {dispatch_agent_id} slot in the break-glass manual template. A real product gap, not a stale test. Retirement settled as fact: the legacy envelope needs TeamCreate, absent from every supported host in the merged CI floor (#390, build.go:338), so nothing can consume it. Keep-list drawn deliberately: internal/claudeteam is the SURVIVING auto-team seam — only LegacyTeamNameAdvisory and MemberExists retire, both reconcile.go files stay. Recommends KEEP selected-team, bind it under the existing sonnet-flake owner, and ship the slot binding. Surface: net -500 across ~49 files (+120/-620); product -180, tests -320, docs 0; tolerance net [-250,-750], files <=60. Declared net because the task is removal and gross would count deletions as growth.
